gapsTheseArtifactsShow.what: THE PANEL CANNOT CREATE A NODE.
gapsTheseArtifactsShow.detail: select, set, duplicate, group, align, distribute, bind and action all operate on nodes that already exist. duplicate needs something to copy. So the skeleton had to come from document.import, and W5's palette - the half that inserts - is not built. Node creation through the sanctioned surface still means a hand-written insert transaction.

gapsTheseArtifactsShow.what: THE BOUND TITLE IS NOT IN THE MANIFEST.
gapsTheseArtifactsShow.detail: The compiled program reports 'state dependencies 0' for this artifact even though nd2 carries textKey st.dialogTitle. That is the bind-text defect recorded earlier today - KEY_PHASES has no textKey, text dynamism goes through the classes mechanism - and here it is in a real artifact rather than a probe: a dialog whose title would freeze at build.

gapsTheseArtifactsShow.what: THREE OF THE FOUR LAYOUT CALLS WERE REFUSED AS NO-OPS.
gapsTheseArtifactsShow.detail: align and distribute declined on already-aligned and already-distributed selections, saying an empty transaction would still be a history entry. Correct, and it means these four artifacts exercise BIND and ACTION heavily and the geometry operations barely - a seeded skeleton is already tidy. Authoring that actually moves boxes needs the palette, or a skeleton deliberately left crooked.
